$comment: What the travel agent is allowed to draw. This prunes the PROMPT, not any renderer — every client keeps its full component registry, so nothing about a Web, Swift, Kotlin or Flutter client changes when a name leaves this list. Applied by `skillgen --prune`, which mirrors A2uiCatalog.with_pruning from the Python agent SDK.
why: The catalog inherits the whole basic catalog. A travel agent will never draw a video player or a modal, but it pays for their signatures on every first turn and re-reads them on every cache miss. Narrowing the list keeps the model's attention on the components it actually composes with.
whyFunctions: The rest of the catalog's functions are check-rule validators — required, regex, length, numeric, email — plus the boolean combinators that compose them. They exist for a `checks=` argument this agent never writes, and they cost more prompt than the six pruned components put together. The formatters stay: they are what makes a surface recompute on screen without a model turn.

excluded.AudioPlayer: no audio in a trip planner
excluded.Video: no video in a trip planner
excluded.Modal: the conversation is the modal; a surface that covers the chat hides the record
excluded.Tabs: the three surfaces are the navigation; tabs inside one of them compete with it
excluded.Divider: Column spacing already separates sections, and the model reaches for it as filler
excluded.DateTimeInput: DateRangePicker covers every date question this agent asks, and offering both invites a single-date control where a range belongs
